checklist.detail: NARloy-Z Copper Alloy (Cu-Ag-Zr): computed wall temp 905 K EXCEEDS its 800 K max service temp (Tc 3480 K, regenerative cooling). Marginal/unsuitable as designed. Basis: coupled throat wall balance: gas h_g ~7.0 kW/m2K incl. carbon-deposit credit, coolant ~35 m/s (h_c ~23.5 kW/m2K, coolant-side wall ~897 K), 0.20 mm wall. Levers that lower it: faster coolant (Coolant velocity; SP-8087 caps liquids at ~61 m/s, at a jacket-dP cost), a thinner wall, a liner rated hotter or more conductive (e.g. GRCop-84), or more film cooling.
checklist.name: Chamber material thermal margin

checklist.detail: Hottest cooled-wall station is in the throat (area ratio ~1.1): coupled wall balance ~930 K, over that section's material limit (0.86x). Levers: more chamber film (or a convergent film ring for the throat region), faster coolant, a thinner or more conductive liner.
